title: P2122 - P2122/008482
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri Harness Issue for Accelerator Pedal Assembly
stepByStepSolution: Inspect Throttle Pedal and Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri Harness.  See Factory Repair Manual.
technicalNotes: The signal voltage for the Accelerator Pedal could be shared with other engine components, O2 sensors for example.
